Author: MrReeh
Name: Hunger Meter
Description: Drives Customize+ waist scale from your Well Fed food buff. Starts at a configurable Baseline, decays toward a configurable Minimum over time, and jumps up toward a configurable Maximum every time you eat. Displayed as a small chicken-leg HUD gauge. Fully configurable in-game via a settings window. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Punchline: Turns eating food into a waist-scaling meter.
